release_notes: Dashboard data blocks became clickable: a row in the Campaigns / Offers / Landings / Sources top opens that entity's settings, the Keitaro habit. Campaigns land straight in the multi-tab campaign editor; offers, landings and sources land on their page with the editor already open (a PWA landing opens in its own constructor). Read-only users get the plain list page instead of a form every save on would 403. A hover hint is translated into all 7 panel languages. No schema changes; frontend only.
